## Full Documents

### magpie-runtime Architecture Overview

# magpie-runtime Architecture Overview

Official architecture documentation and production specifications for magpie-runtime

## Core Subsystems

- **Execution Layer**: Deterministic processing pipeline with bounded concurrency.
- **Routing & State**: Partitioned metadata index for predictable lookup latency.
- **Observability**: Structured telemetry hooks and health probes.

### magpie-runtime Technical Specifications

# magpie-runtime Technical Specifications

Operational contracts, configuration defaults, and interface guarantees for **magpie-runtime**.

| Parameter | Default | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Transport | HTTPS / TLS 1.3 | Edge & Core |
| Encoding | UTF-8 | Content & Metadata |
| Compatibility | POSIX / Cross-Platform | Runtime |

# System Topology & Integration Guide

Practical integration guide for configuring **magpie-runtime** across local and distributed environments.

## Prerequisites

- Network egress rules aligned with target services
